backtracking search. Your job is NOT to replace it with a static script (that fails — the
search is needed). Instead make the SAME tactic do LESS work and reach the SAME state, faster.

Allowed reduction techniques (you MAY still use auto/fastforce/blast/simp/clarsimp):

    the goal first, so the following search tactic has far less to explore;
  - drop an expensive/looping rewrite: `apply (fastforce simp del: <rule>)`, `apply (auto simp del: <rule>)`;
  - use a TARGETED simpset instead of the default: `fastforce simp: <only the needed defs>` (no big bundles);
  - split: `apply clarsimp` then a small close;
  - reorder: cheap structural rules (conjI/clarify) before the heavy search.
